title: RouteLens Driver App
shortDescription: A driver application for route execution, exception handling and proof of delivery, with live progress streaming to dispatch.
fullDescription: RouteLens gives drivers a single screen for the run ahead: ordered stops, navigation handoff, one-tap exception reporting and structured proof of delivery. Dispatch sees progress and estimated arrival in real time, and customers receive accurate notifications automatically instead of a phone call from the office.
imageAlt: Abstract mobile route execution layout with ordered stops and status indicators

features.title: Ordered run view
features.description: The full route as a single sequence, with the next action always the largest thing on screen.

features.title: One-tap exceptions
features.description: Structured reasons for failed or partial delivery, captured in seconds at the door.

features.title: Proof of delivery
features.description: Signature, photo and geotagged timestamp bundled and uploaded per stop.

features.title: Live ETA streaming
features.description: Position and progress stream to dispatch, driving automatic customer notifications.

features.title: Low-connectivity tolerance
features.description: Stop completion is recorded locally and queued when coverage drops.

features.title: Driver-safe interaction
features.description: Large targets, high contrast and minimal typing, designed for use in a vehicle.

challenge.summary: Dispatch had no visibility into a run until the driver called in, and proof of delivery was a paper sheet photographed at the end of the day.
points: Delivery status was unknown between depot departure and return.
Customer arrival estimates were guesses relayed by the office.
Paper proof of delivery meant disputes were resolved days later, if at all.
Failed deliveries were reported inconsistently, so root causes were invisible.

solution.summary: We designed the app around what a driver can safely do in ten seconds at a doorstep, and streamed everything else to the office automatically.
points: Reduced each stop to a single primary action with structured, tappable outcomes.
Captured proof of delivery as a bundled artefact with signature, photo and geotag.
Streamed position and progress so dispatch and customer notifications need no phone calls.
Queued completions locally so poor coverage never blocks a driver.
Standardised exception reasons, making failure causes measurable for the first time.
